title: Aaron Glenn is expecting big things from Geno Smith as Jets quarterback

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Aaron Glenn is expecting big things from Geno Smith as Jets quarterback
sources.description: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn spoke to the media on Tuesday at the NFL league meeting. Glenn set big expectations for Geno Smith’s second stint with the Jets. Of course any coach is going to say positive things about the quarterback his team just acquired. The Jets were aggressive in going after Smith this offseason, […]
